categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Build system' and updates Qt build recipes and patches in depends.
categories.rationale: Updating Qt to 6.12 LTS brings upstream bug fixes and official support for newer macOS releases ('The new Qt 6.12 LTS contains many bug fixes and officially supports macOS 26'). The update is worthwhile for platform support and dependency hygiene, but reasonably deferrable in the absence of an active release deadline or blocking platform failure.
